resources.string: Bilibili has used three streaming formats. DASH was introduced in 2018 and remains the main format. MP4 and FLV are now used only in limited cases.
Bilibili’s current streaming format offers the best audio and video quality and the fastest downloads.
Keep this format for most downloads. If you are unsure, leave Stream format unchanged.
Audio and video are delivered separately in segments. The video stream has no sound, and the audio stream has no picture.
To create a single file with both audio and video, the streams must be merged using FFmpeg. Select the Audio and video output type to do this.
Do not choose this just because you want an MP4 file. Downloads are usually slower and lower quality than DASH.
This format delivers MP4 files with audio already included, so merging is unnecessary.
This format is rarely used now, except for previews of paid shows, films, and courses. Such previews are often only available as MP4 with limited picture and sound quality.
The segmented FLV format used in earlier years has almost entirely been retired.
This option is kept for compatibility and archiving. Some older content may still be downloadable, but FLV is not recommended for everyday use.
Keep the default DASH format unless you need another format.
